summary:
Suburban McMansion on a 44x32 cul-de-sac lot: an 18-wide three-car garage wing with a bonus room, and a 26x22 two-storey main block with a 10-wide entry gable, portico and turret bay. Deepslate-tile roofs (hips with flat decks, ridge y14), stone veneer under birch siding, quartz trim and quoins, iron shutters, a chimney, driveway, lawn with shrubs and tree, and a back deck.
No code was run beyond block-id checks; design files are elements.md and plan.md.

concept_subject: A suburban McMansion seen from the street (north), 44 blocks wide, two storeys plus attic, on a flat cul-de-sac lot of manicured green lawn. On the left an 18-wide three-car garage wing in beige siding over a stone-veneer base. It has three 4-wide carriage-style doors (spruce panels with glass windows above) separated by lantern posts, and a hipped dark-asphalt roof. A wide grey concrete driveway flares to the street in front of it. At the centre a tall 10-wide gable-fronted entry, whose ridge is the highest point of the house, holds a two-storey portico with four white quartz columns, a white pediment and a double dark door under a fanlight, up three stone steps from a polished-andesite walk. To its right a round-ish turret bay in stone veneer with tall glass windows and a conical dark roof with a rod finial. Behind and around them the main block carries a jumble of hipped dark deepslate-tile roofs with flat decks and two small gabled dormers. A big stone-brick chimney with two pots rises on the right. The facade mixes stone veneer on the lower front, beige birch siding above, and white trim with alternating quoins at the corners. Tall arched windows (3 wide, with upside-down quartz stairs in the top corners) have black iron shutters. Foundation shrubs of leaf and azalea blocks run along the front wall, and a young oak with a stake stands in the lawn near the driveway. At the back is a spruce deck with a fence rail and a sliding glass door.
concept_size: 44 wide (x), 32 deep (z), 2 storeys plus attic, 14 tall to the top ridge (lawn and driveway included)
concept_palette: Stone veneer: stone_bricks (stairs, slab, wall); beige siding: birch_planks; white trim, quoins and columns: smooth_quartz, quartz_pillar, white_concrete; roof: deepslate_tiles (stairs, slab); shutters: iron_trapdoor; windows: glass_pane; doors: dark_oak_door; garage doors: spruce_planks with spruce_trapdoor panels; driveway: gray_concrete; path: polished_andesite; lawn: grass_block; shrubs: oak_leaves and flowering_azalea_leaves; deck: spruce_planks and spruce_fence; lights: lantern.
